test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required’.**

__She had no sooner taken a few steps forward that__ she suddenly recoiled.

options.text: No sooner had she taken a few steps forward than
She did no sooner taken a few steps forward than
She did no sooner took a few steps forward than

solution:
The correct answer is: **No sooner had she taken a few steps forward than **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**No sooner**" is used to show that one thing happens immediately after another thing.
 
• It is often used with the past perfect, and usually followed by "**than**."
